title: DRelay: Global Draft Context for Prefix-Aware Parallel Speculative Decoding Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.01439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parallel drafting reduces the drafting overhead of speculative decoding for large language models (LLMs), but its gains remain limited by the accepted prefix length. Even when the correct token is present in the candidate pool, a single early selection error prevents subsequent predictions from being used. We propose DRelay, which uses global information from the entire draft block to perform prefix-aware selective repair of candidate selections before target-model verification. DRelay bases its decisions on candidate correlations and the selected path: a global reader extracts predictive information across positions for each candidate. While a causal selector combines candidate-level information extracted by the global read with the tokens selected at preceding positions to determine whether the native choice at the current position is consistent with the global evidence and the selected prefix. translated_title: DRelay：面向前缀感知并行推测解码修复的全局草稿上下文
translated_abstract: 并行草稿生成降低了大语言模型（LLM）推测解码的草稿生成开销，但其收益仍受限于被接受的前缀长度。即使正确的token存在于候选池中，一个早期的选择错误也会导致后续的预测无法被利用。我们提出了DRelay，它利用整个草稿块的全局信息，在目标模型验证之前对候选选择进行前缀感知的选择性修复。DRelay基于候选相关性以及已被选定的路径来做出决策：一个全局读取器为每个候选提取跨位置的预测信息，而一个因果选择器将全局读取器提取的候选级信息与前序位置已选定的token相结合，判断当前位置的原始选择是否与全局证据和已选前缀一致，进而决定是保留还是修复该选择。
tldr: DRelay利用整个草稿块的全局上下文信息，在目标模型验证前对并行推测解码的候选选择进行前缀感知的选择性修复，从而避免单个早期选择错误导致后续预测全部失效。
en_tdlr: DRelay leverages global draft-block context to perform prefix-aware selective repair of candidate selections before verification in parallel speculative decoding, preventing a single early selection error from invalidating subsequent predictions.
